lines: Dil-e-naadaan, tujhe hua kya hai?
Aakhir is dard ki dawa kya hai?
couplets.en: What has come over you, foolish heart, and what can ease this pain?

lines: Hum ko un se wafa ki hai ummeed
Jo nahin jaante wafa kya hai
couplets.en: I look for constancy from one who has never known it.

lines: Mushtaaq aur woh bezaar
Hum hain mushtaaq aur woh bezaar
couplets.en: I am full of longing, and they have grown weary of me.

lines: Mushtaaq aur woh bezaar
Ya Ilaahi, yeh maajra kya hai?
couplets.en: I long for them and they grow weary of me, so what am I to make of it, Lord?

lines: Dil-e-naadaan, tujhe hua kya hai?
Dil-e-naadaan, tujhe hua kya hai?
couplets.en: What has come over you, foolish heart?

lines: Jab ki tujh bin nahin koi maujood
couplets.en: There is no one here but You.

lines: Jab ki tujh bin nahin koi maujood
couplets.en: There is no one here but You.

lines: Phir yeh hangaama, ai Khuda, kya hai?
Dil-e-naadaan, tujhe hua kya hai?
couplets.en: Then what is all this tumult, Lord, and what has come over you, foolish heart?

lines: Jaan tum pe nisaar karta hoon
couplets.en: I lay down my life for you.

lines: Jaan tum pe nisaar karta hoon
Main nahin jaanta dua kya hai
couplets.en: I lay down my life for you, for I know nothing of prayer.
